title: Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.08253v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution, but existing finite-support or quantile-based methods rely on projections, while recent flow-based approaches can suffer from \emph{boundary mismatch} at the flow source or from \emph{high-variance} bootstrapping when current and successor noises are independent. We propose Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF), a continuous-time DRL method that learns return distributions with flow matching using \textbf{source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths}: the current path starts from the required base prior at $t{=}0$, reaches the Bellman target at $t{=}1$, and maintains a pathwise affine relation to the successor flow at intermediate times (without requiring time-$t$ marginals to satisfy a distributional Bellman fixed point for all $t$). PCBF couples current and successor return flows through shared base noise and uses a $\lambda$-parameterized control-variate targe

translated_title: 面向分布式强化学习的路径耦合贝尔曼流
translated_abstract: 分布式强化学习（DRL）对完整的回报分布进行建模，但现有的有限支撑或基于分位数的方法依赖于投影操作，而近期的基于流的方法则可能在流源处出现边界失配，或在当前噪声与后继噪声相互独立时产生高方差的自举问题。我们提出了路径耦合贝尔曼流（PCBF），这是一种连续时间的分布式强化学习方法，它通过“源一致且经贝尔曼耦合的路径”利用流匹配来学习回报分布：当前路径在 t=0 时从所需的基础先验出发，在 t=1 时到达贝尔曼目标，并在中间时刻与后继流保持逐路径的仿射关系（无需要求所有时刻 t 的边际分布均满足分布式贝尔曼不动点）。PCBF 通过共享基础噪声将当前与后继的回报流耦合起来，并使用一种以 λ 参数化的控制变量目标……
tldr: 提出 PCBF 方法，通过源一致的贝尔曼耦合路径与共享基础噪声进行流匹配，在连续时间框架下学习回报分布，同时避免了投影、边界失配与高方差自举问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF), a continuous-time distributional RL method that learns return distributions via flow matching with source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths and shared base noise, avoiding projections, boundary mismatch, and high-variance bootstrapping.
